title: A boldog békeidők és a századforduló (The Belle Époque & Its Shadows)
grammar: Dual State Structures, Commemorative Postpositions & Urban Innovation Verbs

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Happy Peacetime was and which tensions lay under it.
I can use miközben to set a bright side against a dark side.
I can name emigration, the nationalities question and social tension in a citizenship interview.
I can read a short text about the turn of the century and answer questions about it.
